title: shadcn/improve
claim: shadcn/improve — Use your most capable model to audit your codebase and write plans for cheaper models to execute.
why_good: A model-tiering pattern from shadcn: an expensive model plans, a cheap model executes — a concrete way to cut agent cost without losing quality.
value: Could become a routing/planning layer teams pay for (spend control + quality); the wedge is orchestrating strong+cheap models.
risk: It's a pattern/tool the agent frameworks (and shadcn's own ecosystem) can absorb; thin as a standalone business.

zh.claim: shadcn/improve —— 用你最强的模型审计代码库、写计划,再交给便宜模型执行。
zh.why_good: 来自 shadcn 的模型分层范式:贵模型做规划、便宜模型执行——在不掉质量的前提下砍 agent 成本的具体做法。
zh.value: 可能变成团队付费的路由/规划层(花费管控 + 质量);切口是编排强+便宜两档模型。
zh.risk: 它是个会被 agent 框架(和 shadcn 自己生态)吸收的范式/工具;做独立生意偏薄。

voices.quote: …nce? — Hey — thanks for this skill, I've been leaning on it a lot. Running into something I can't figure out from the docs and wanted to ask before inventing my own convention. `plans/` lives at the repo root and gets committed…
